correctness.rationale: Restriction of quadratics modulo the circumsphere is H0⊕H1⊕H2 of dimension nine. Direct weighted character inner products establish 3+5 irreducibility for the icosahedral group, and 3+2+3 pairwise inequivalent irreducibility for the octahedral group. The representation kernel lemma, together with explicit nonvanishing of each constituent on the orbit seed, proves every nonzero icosahedral orbit and exactly the non-cube/non-octahedron octahedral orbits have zero restriction kernel. The finite Archimedean classification supplies six orbits of each, and an exact 4-sign Fourier calculation proves the truncated-tetrahedral case. Exact symbolic verifier independently checks rank, characters, sphere kernels and sample orbit ranks; it does not substitute for the general proof. No boundary or normalization cases are omitted.

value.rationale: Resolves the exact published Conjecture 1 covering thirteen classical Archimedean solids with one structural argument, and proves stronger sharp orbit criteria. Quantifies true exceptions to quadratic rigidity under the octahedral group, rather than computing arbitrary parameters or a routine case. Unifies chiral and nonchiral cases with a reusable representation-theoretic method.
